summary: Michael Jackson: The Experience is Ubisoft's licensed dance/music-game adaptation, split across motion-control, handheld, and rhythm-game platform versions.

entries.title: Michael Jackson: The Experience
entries.definitive_edition: Owned motion-console version with controller/camera setup documented

emulation.notes: Original motion hardware required for fidelity.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original console hardware with motion-controller/camera setup documented

primary.version: Motion-control console route, selected by hardware availability
primary.why: The game was built around motion-control performance, and the Wii, Kinect, and PlayStation Move routes preserve different input/camera expectations. There is no normal current storefront route, so the archive route is owned disc media and original hardware.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned console disc with the relevant motion hardware. Record platform, controller/camera setup, song, difficulty, player count, scoring/calibration, DLC or song-list state, and whether handheld rhythm versions were compared.

secondary.why: They are not equivalent to full-body motion console routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record platform, calibration, and song-list/DLC state.
